_about: Index of Go problem collections, with verified licences. Metadata only: this file contains no problem content. Compiled 2026-08-18 by a multi-agent survey with an adversarial licence-verification pass; see docs/PROBLEM-SOURCES.md for method and caveats.
_warning: A public-domain POSITION does not make a machine-readable FILE of it public domain. Every convenient SGF transcription of the classics carries either no licence, a code-only licence, or added solution trees that are new copyright. Verify before use.
_grid: the (phase x concept) grid lives in data/taxonomy_map.json under 'grid' — one copy, so the two files cannot drift

reusable.name: Go Game Guru weekly go problems
reusable.format: SGF FF[4], annotated solution trees with wrong-answer branches

difficulty.note: repo README concedes grading is 'fairly subjective'

licence.note: site's own grant was 3.0 (verified via Wayback 2012-01-18 footer/ToS); repo LICENSE ships the 4.0 legal code

blocks: relicensing: ShareAlike is incompatible with this repo's MIT licence

reusable.name: Sensei's Library wiki dump
reusable.format: SQL dump -> wiki ASCII diagrams; full snapshot tarballs also contain SGF

difficulty.note: richest structured difficulty metadata in any open Go corpus

licence.note: OPL s1 forbids charging a fee for network access; OPL s2(b) is copyleft over the whole derivative

blocks: combining into a non-OPL work: OPL s2(b) is viral
caveats: only ~137 distinct pages carry any phase tag
dump rows have variable trailing columns: index from the FRONT (difficulty=field 7, keywords=field 8) or undercount by ~30%

reusable.name: Gokyo Shumyo, 1912 edition (National Diet Library)
reusable.format: IIIF page scans. NOT machine-readable; re-keying required

difficulty.note: seven classical topical sections, ungraded: life 103, death 71, ko 90, capturing races 96, chasing 40, connect-underneath 74, wedge/cut/ladder 46

licence.note: Public Domain Mark read from the IIIF manifest access-restrictions field; item HTML and item API both fail, the manifest endpoint works

caveats: re-keying from the scan is the only clean-room route to licence-free SGF of these positions

licence.note: same verification method as Gokyo Shumyo

reusable.name: Lichess puzzle database

licence.note: verified verbatim on the download page

blocks: IT IS CHESS. Validation/calibration only. Must not enter a Go catalogue.
reusable.why_here: the only freely reusable attempt-derived puzzle-rating dataset in existence, and the exact methodological precedent for this project
